PREMIERE316 STYLE-ONLY IMAGE REFERENCE CONTROL — V2
Asset ID: prop-guardian-sword
Workflow profile: 2X3_VERTICAL (2:3)
Reference mode: ART DIRECTION ONLY — NO SUBJECT OR DESIGN TRANSFER.

The loaded images are non-content style plates. The asset prompt below is the sole authority for subject, identity, age, ethnicity, anatomy, wardrobe design, prop design, environment geometry, creatures, crowd population, pose, action, camera composition, wounds, blood placement, text, and all story content.

ALLOWED TRANSFER ONLY: overall palette; contrast curve; key/fill/rim relationship; volumetric-light behavior; atmosphere density; material highlight and shadow response; lens/exposure language; practical texture fidelity; cinematic depth; restrained film grain.

FORBIDDEN TRANSFER: faces or facial geometry; body identity or proportions; hairstyles; costume silhouettes; wounds or blood maps; weapons or props; architecture or set geography; creature designs; crowd layout; pose; framing; four-panel layout; lettering; logos; or any recognizable object from a reference, unless the asset prompt itself explicitly requests that exact element.

Prop/artifact guard: transfer only material response, patina, highlight rolloff, and photographic presentation. Do not add a glowing sword, sacred symbols, blood, or human hands unless this row explicitly requires them.

Active plate roles: warm-gold lighting and highlight rolloff; smoky umber shadow palette and ember atmosphere; abstract filmic tonal/material response and restrained grain.
When a reference conflicts with the row prompt, ignore the reference and obey the row prompt.

AUTHORITATIVE ASSET PROMPT
--------------------------
GUARDIAN LEADER TWO-HANDED SWORD — PRODUCTION REFERENCE: HERO PROP DESIGN, CONSTRUCTION, MATERIALS, SCALE, AND CONTINUITY.

Photorealistic live-action production reference, physically coherent lighting, exact anatomy, clean hands, consistent scale and materials, no captions, no logos, no watermarks, no borders, and no written or graphical elements.

Hero production prop of Hell's Guardian Leader two-handed greatsword from the biblical epic JESUS: THE HARROWING OF HELL, shown as a complete isolated weapon for VFX and costume matching against the fortress gate confrontation. Overall scale is enormous and non-human: overall length approximately six to seven feet from pommel to tip, mass and proportions sized for an eight-foot armored champion, blade alone roughly four and a half feet of broad cutting steel with a long two-hand grip. Construction reads as ancient black iron forged in the depths, not polished parade steel—surface is pitted, flaked, and deeply oxidized to charcoal, graphite, and dull iron-oxide brown-black, with cold blue torch speculars catching only the highest ridges. The blade is a long double-edged spadone silhouette with a slight taper to a brutal spear point, fullers cut as dual shallow blood channels running two-thirds of the length, edges nicked and hammer-scarred from millennia of use, tip still lethal but micro-chipped. Along both faces of the blade, irregular dark viscous substance—black-crimson ichor thicker than blood, almost tar-like—slowly drips and beads from the edges and fuller, catching red underglow (#350000–#8B0000 range) as wet highlights; some dried crusts of the same substance cling in scaly layers near the ricasso and along the lower third of the blade. Crossguard is a heavy straight or slightly downturned iron bar with crude claw-like terminations, welded joints uneven, rivets hammered flat and corroded green-black at the cores. Grip is long enough for two massive gauntleted hands: wrapped in desiccated dark leather strips over a core of wood or bone, leather cracked, salt-white deposits and old blood-black staining in the wrap gaps, wire or sinew bindings frayed at the ends. Pommel is a heavy iron disc or faceted knob, scarred and dented, weight counterbalancing the oversized blade; a faint ring of dried ichor around the pommel seat. Optional subtle hell-forged details only: faint damascene-like warp lines in the iron, tiny pockmarks as if struck by heat and sulfur, no readable runes, no modern maker marks, no logos. Material continuity locks with Guardian Leader corroded black iron armor—same age, same sulfur-and-blood patina, same battle abuse language. Lighting: cold blue torch key ~2000K from one side casting hard metal edge rims, low red underglow ~3500K from below licking the dripping ichor, soft ambient hell gloom so the weapon reads fully three-dimensional without pure silhouette; subtle volumetric dust and thin ash motes in air, no divine gold light on this object. Camera: three-quarter hero prop angle or pure profile product-style framing, 85–100mm feel, shallow depth of field with the entire sword still sharp and complete in frame, 2.39:1 cinematic widescreen crop optional but object must remain fully visible. Color grade: deep crimsons, obsidian blacks, cold royal-blue speculars, wet red-black drips; photoreal live-action practical prop photography language, physical metal wear, real leather grain, true liquid viscosity on the ichor—not illustration, not anime, not glossy fantasy CGI toy. Continuity note: this is the visual-spec weapon of the Guardian Leader (Hell's Champion) for character and VFX match; rank-and-file guardians primarily carry spears in screenplay action, but this greatsword is the leader's signature two-handed arm dripping dark living substance before the gate challenge. No modern objects, no scabbard with logos, no museum plaques, no floating text, no watermarks, no UI. Neutral production reference framing, the complete object visible, accurate materials and scale, no labels or text.
